positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: How should remember hand extraction off to the background so the caller is never blocked and no work is lost when the client drops its receipt?
positions.why: The three statements read one design direction: remember returns a receipt immediately, extraction is watched by a polling cursor (src-2), the call never blocks and work survives a dropped receipt (src-3), and the dispatch model is settled as dispatch-then-observe, with the agent either polling the run or receiving the reaction piggybacked on a later call (src-4). src-2 names polling alone, while src-4 offers piggybacked reaction as a second route; that difference is left open rather than resolved. src-2 and src-3 are attributed to Wynn Castellano and src-4 to the memo author, so the decision is carried by two voices.
